# Core Policy Interface Mapping

**Auto-generated by `sarathi init --init`**

This file maps each lifecycle phase to its required policy inputs, enabling dual-source validation between the engine's expected interfaces and the policy pack's actual outputs.

## Mapping Table

| Phase | Required Input | Policy File | Status |
|-------|---------------|-------------|--------|
| Route | Complexity triggers | `complexity.md` | Pending |
| Route | Complexity classification rules | `complexity.md` | Pending |
| Brainstorm | Exploration prompts | Policy pack | Pending |
| Plan | Plan structure requirements | Policy pack | Pending |
| Execute | Build/test commands | `commands.md` | Pending |
| Execute | Conventions | `conventions.md` | Pending |
| Review | Review criteria | `review.md` | Pending |
| Review | Evidence requirements | `review.md` | Pending |
| Ship | Escalation thresholds | `escalation.md` | Pending |

## Running Validation

```bash
# Validate all policy inputs against required interfaces
sarathi validate

# Check specific phase
sarathi validate --phase <phase-name>
```

Validation confirms that each phase's required inputs have corresponding policy definitions. Any `Status: Missing` indicates a gap in the policy pack that must be addressed before the workflow can run.
